definition: Jiliang Tang is a Chinese-born computer scientist and a University Foundation Professor of Computer Science and Engineering at Michigan State University, where he is the director of the Data Science and Engineering (DSE) Lab.
details: His research expertise is in data mining and machine learning.

explainer.lead: Jiliang Tang is a Computer scientist. His work spans software engineering, machine learning and data mining.

timeline.what: He received his BEng in software engineering (2008) and MSc in computer science (2010) from the Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, China.
His PhD is from Arizona State University (2015), under the direction of Huan Liu.
